entities.name: On the Origin of Species
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Charles Darwin's landmark work (1859) presenting the theory of evolution by natural selection, supported by evidence from biogeography, fossil record, morphology, and embryology. It overturned the prevailing view of species as immutable creations, provoked one of the greatest intellectual revolutions in history, and remains the foundation of modern biology.
